description: Scope mirrors the Dependabot config this replaces: GitHub Actions only, Mondays before 9am Europe/Zurich, labels dependencies + release:patch, chore(deps) commits.
Never automerge: every PR needs a maintainer-added patch bump (VERSION, README, CHANGELOG) before the release-metadata check passes, and CONTRIBUTING forbids automation merging to main.
Runners stay on ubuntu-24.04 deliberately (ci.yml needs its apt configobj): no runner-label bumps.
Repo policy wins over the shared preset's automerge rule.
